note: Two adjudicated accidental variants (punctuation only). Substantive text agrees across both witnesses with zero divergence.

adjudicated.ruling: No comma before the relative, with handmissal-eo and with the corpus ruling at ordinarium.quid-retribuam w005 for the same word before the same kind of clause. Pro quibus illud óbtuli says which ómnibus are meant — the priest prayed for them by intention at the Memento — and defining the group is not a remark that can be lifted out of the sentence.
No comma before the apposition Dóminum nostrum, with handmissal-eo and with the corpus ruling at ordinarium.aufer-a-nobis w018 for the same closing formula.
